# F174 — Component: Frontend shared filter kit

## Existing building blocks (reuse, do NOT modify their APIs)
- `frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx` — `SearchBar({ value, onChange, placeholder? })`
- `frontend/src/components/SortSelect.tsx` — `SortSelect({ options: SortOption[], value: "sortBy-sortDir", onChange(sortBy, sortDir) })`.
  `SortOption = { labelKey, sortBy, sortDir }`. Also exports
  `COLLECTION_SORT_OPTIONS`, `EXPLORE_SORT_OPTIONS`, `CATALOG_SORT_OPTIONS`.
  **Do not edit this file.** Trade sort lists live in a new file.
- `frontend/src/components/SetIconFilter.tsx` — `SetIconFilter({ options: {label,value}[], selected, onSelect })`, testid `set-icon-filter`.
- `frontend/src/components/FilterChips.tsx` — `FilterChips({ options: {label,value,icon?}[], selected, onSelect })`, testid `filter-chips`, "All" chip `filter-chip-all`.
- `frontend/src/components/GridSizeToggle.tsx` + `hooks/useGridSize.ts`
  (localStorage `tcg:grid-size`, shared across pages on purpose) and
  `utils/constants.ts` → `GRID_SIZE_CONFIG[size].gridClasses` / `.compact`.
- `frontend/src/components/Skeleton.tsx` → `SkeletonCard`.
- `frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts` (300 ms is used everywhere),
  `hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts` (`const sentinelRef = useInfiniteScroll(loadMore, { enabled })`).

## MyCollection's sticky bar (the reference markup — MyCollection.tsx ~L752)
```tsx
<div className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-sm pb-4 pt-2 -mx-6 px-6 border-b border-slate-700/50 space-y-4 mb-6" data-testid="sticky-filter-bar">
  <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
    <div className="flex-1"><SearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} /></div>
    <SortSelect options={COLLECTION_SORT_OPTIONS} value={`${sortBy}-${sortDir}`} onChange={handleSortChange} />
  </div>
  {setOptions.length > 0 && <SetIconFilter options={setOptions} selected={selectedSet} onSelect={setSelectedSet} />}
  {/* acquisition chips, mobile actions row (sm:hidden) + GridSizeToggle, desktop actions row (hidden sm:flex) + GridSizeToggle */}
</div>
```

## New: `frontend/src/components/CardFilterBar.tsx`
```ts
export interface CardFilterBarProps {
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (v: string) => void;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  sortOptions: SortOption[];
  sortValue: string;                               // "sortBy-sortDir"
  onSortChange: (sortBy: string, sortDir: "asc" | "desc") => void;
  setOptions?: { label: string; value: string }[]; // row hidden when empty/undefined
  selectedSet?: string | null;
  onSetSelect?: (v: string | null) => void;
  gridSize?: GridSize;                             // when set → renders actions row with GridSizeToggle
  onGridSizeChange?: (s: GridSize) => void;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;                       // left of GridSizeToggle in the actions row
  children?: React.ReactNode;                      // extra rows (chips, page-specific rows) after set filter
  testId?: string;                                 // default "sticky-filter-bar"
}
```
Render order: row 1 (search flex-1 + sort), row 2 SetIconFilter (if options),
`children`, then — only when `gridSize && onGridSizeChange` — a row
`<div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-3" data-testid="filter-bar-actions">{actions}<GridSizeToggle/></div>`.
Container classes are identical to the reference markup above.

## New: `frontend/src/utils/cardListFilter.ts` (pure, no React)
```ts
export interface CardListAccessors<T> {
  name: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;
  namePt?: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;
  setCode: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;
  number?: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;
  price?: (i: T) => number | null | undefined;
  date?: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;     // ISO
  status?: (i: T) => string | null | undefined;
}
export function filterCardList<T>(items: T[], f: { search?: string; set?: string | null; status?: string | null }, acc: CardListAccessors<T>): T[];
export function sortCardList<T>(items: T[], sortBy: string, sortDir: "asc" | "desc", acc: CardListAccessors<T>): T[];
export function buildSetOptions<T>(items: T[], acc: CardListAccessors<T>): { label: string; value: string }[];
```
Rules: search is case- and accent-insensitive
(`normalize("NFD").replace(/\p{Diacritic}/gu, "")`) over name + namePt. The set
comparison is case-insensitive. Sorting is stable and returns a new array (it never mutates the input).
Null/empty values always sort last in both directions. `number` uses natural
compare (`localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true })`). An unknown `sortBy`
returns a copy in the original order. `buildSetOptions` returns unique codes
with `value` in lowercase and `label` in uppercase, sorted by label.

## New: `frontend/src/utils/tradeSortOptions.ts`
Reuses existing `sort.*` label keys where possible, and new keys live under `tradeFilters.*`:
```ts
export const MARKETPLACE_SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = [
  { labelKey: "sort.nameAZ", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.nameZA", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "desc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.set", sortBy: "set", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.cardNumber", sortBy: "number", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.priceHighLow", sortBy: "price", sortDir: "desc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.priceLowHigh", sortBy: "price", sortDir: "asc" },
];
export const DUPLICATES_SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = [
  { labelKey: "tradeFilters.sortQuantityDesc", sortBy: "quantity", sortDir: "desc" },
  ...MARKETPLACE_SORT_OPTIONS,
];
export const MY_TRADES_SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = [
  { labelKey: "tradeFilters.sortNewest", sortBy: "date", sortDir: "desc" },
  { labelKey: "tradeFilters.sortOldest", sortBy: "date", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.nameAZ", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.nameZA", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "desc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.set", sortBy: "set", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "tradeFilters.sortStatus", sortBy: "status", sortDir: "asc" },
];
export const MATCH_SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = [
  { labelKey: "sort.nameAZ", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "asc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.nameZA", sortBy: "name", sortDir: "desc" },
  { labelKey: "sort.set", sortBy: "set", sortDir: "asc" },
];
```
`SortSelect` splits on `-`, so a `sortBy` must never contain a dash.

## New: `frontend/src/hooks/useCardListFilters.ts`
```ts
export function useCardListFilters(opts: { defaultSortBy: string; defaultSortDir: "asc" | "desc" }): {
  search: string; setSearch: (v: string) => void; debouncedSearch: string;
  selectedSet: string | null; setSelectedSet: (v: string | null) => void;
  sortBy: string; sortDir: "asc" | "desc"; sortValue: string;
  setSort: (sortBy: string, sortDir: "asc" | "desc") => void;
};
```
- It reads the initial state from URL params `name`, `set`, `sort`, `dir` (the same keys as
  MyCollection) and falls back to the defaults. An invalid `dir` falls back to the default.
- It writes back with `setSearchParams(prev => { … }, { replace: true })`, **preserving
  unrelated params** (e.g. `tab`). It deletes keys that are empty or equal to the default.
- The debounce is 300 ms via `useDebounce`.

## Testing conventions
Vitest + Testing Library. Tests live in `frontend/src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts(x)`.
Mock `react-i18next` with `t: (k) => k` (see
`pages/__tests__/TradeMatchesPage.test.tsx`). Wrap components that use hooks in
`MemoryRouter` (with `initialEntries` for URL tests).
